ability.animal_ken.name: Animal Ken
ability.animal_ken.description: Communicate with animals as if they were people, treating your score as a shared language; lets you substitute Animal Handling for social Abilities with them.

ability.area_lore.name: {area} Lore
ability.area_lore.description: Knowledge of one particular region, covenant, or village — where things are, local history and legends, and the centers of power.

ability.artes_liberales.name: Artes Liberales
ability.artes_liberales.description: The seven liberal arts of the Trivium and Quadrivium, the basis of medieval higher education; also covers reading and writing.

ability.athletics.name: Athletics
ability.athletics.description: General physical prowess — moving smoothly and with grace, and most large-muscle coordination.

ability.awareness.name: Awareness
ability.awareness.description: Noticing things, whether sought or unexpected, and staying alert when watchfulness is required.

ability.brawl.name: Brawl
ability.brawl.description: Fighting hand-to-hand without weapons or with improvised ones; also used to dodge if you have no Martial Abilities.

ability.charm.name: Charm
ability.charm.description: Enticing and endearing others on a personal basis, including winning someone over romantically.

ability.concentration.name: Concentration
ability.concentration.description: Focusing your mental faculties on one task for extended periods; especially important for magi maintaining spells amid distraction.

ability.curse_throwing.name: Curse-Throwing
ability.curse_throwing.description: Heal diseases and remove curses by transferring their effects to another person.

ability.dead_language.name: {language}
ability.dead_language.description: Fluency in a language no longer spoken natively where you have lived — Latin above all, the language of scholarship and the Church; available only to educated characters.

ability.dowsing.name: Dowsing
ability.dowsing.description: Find things nearby through a dowsing rod and your own intuitive sense.

ability.enigmatic_wisdom.name: Enigmatic Wisdom
ability.enigmatic_wisdom.description: The understanding House Criamon magi have of the Enigma; affects Twilight rolls and the deeper mysteries of magic.

ability.etiquette.name: Etiquette
ability.etiquette.description: Knowing the social graces and how to behave properly in different situations — proper behavior rather than charm.

ability.faerie_magic.name: Faerie Magic
ability.faerie_magic.description: The connection to the power of the Faerie realm possessed by House Merinita magi; cannot be learned by others.

ability.finesse.name: Finesse
ability.finesse.description: Manipulating your spells and performing special feats with them, such as positioning objects delicately or targeting spells.

ability.folk_ken.name: Folk Ken
ability.folk_ken.description: Understanding the background, personality, and motives of another person; the storyguide often rolls secretly.

ability.guile.name: Guile
ability.guile.description: Telling convincing lies and feigning emotion or belief; also covers disguise and pretending to be what you are not.

ability.heartbeast.name: Heartbeast
ability.heartbeast.description: The ability shared by all House Bjornaer magi to take the form of their heartbeast; cannot be learned by others.

ability.intrigue.name: Intrigue
ability.intrigue.description: Dealing and plotting — subtle, non-confrontational use of power, negotiation, and gathering useful information about those in power.

ability.living_language.name: {language}
ability.living_language.description: Fluency in a particular living language; your score measures how well you communicate, with the lower score governing a conversation.

ability.magic_theory.name: Magic Theory
ability.magic_theory.description: Knowledge of what magic is and how it works, used primarily in the laboratory; the technical details of Hermetic magic.

ability.penetration.name: Penetration
ability.penetration.description: Getting your spell through the target's Magic Resistance.

ability.premonitions.name: Premonitions
ability.premonitions.description: Intuitively sense when something is wrong or about to go wrong, with a chance to grasp the nature of the danger.
specialties: threats to a particular person or group of people

ability.second_sight.name: Second Sight
ability.second_sight.description: See through illusory concealment and disguise — including invisibility — and perceive naturally invisible things such as spirits and regio boundaries.

ability.sense_holiness_and_unholiness.name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
ability.sense_holiness_and_unholiness.description: Feel the presence of good and evil in an area, person, or object.

ability.single_weapon.name: Single Weapon
ability.single_weapon.description: Fighting with a one-handed weapon, possibly with a shield in the other hand; includes lances used from horseback.

ability.stealth.name: Stealth
ability.stealth.description: Sneaking about unseen and unheard, hiding, and following people without their noticing.

ability.survival.name: Survival
ability.survival.description: Finding food, water, shelter, a route, and relative safety in the wilderness, including making fire and cooking without implements.

ability.swim.name: Swim
ability.swim.description: Propelling yourself through water quickly and efficiently.
